custom_logic_notes: Uses Dynamic R-S Channel indicator for dynamic support/resistance levels. Entry on previous bar close crossing channel boundaries. Exit on price crossing back through middle channel line. The channel indicator is a custom indicator that must be replicated or loaded externally in Python conversion. Digit adjustment logic multiplies SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: The DynamicRS_C_Channel custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. The indicator appears to compute dynamic R-S (resistance-support) channel boundaries. The EA uses only 3 buffers: upper channel, lower channel, and middle line. Entry logic is straightforward: buy when previous bar close crosses above lower channel, sell when previous bar close crosses below upper channel. SL/TP are fixed pip values with 5-digit broker adjustment. Position check prevents stacking. New bar guard ensures one signal per bar.
